Topics · The prophets

What exactly was every messenger told to say?

One sentence to every messenger, and a command not to split over it. Do you know it from your own book?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:25

Translation

I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

Original · Hebrew

אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃

Isaiah · 45:5

World English Bible

In villages that never knew each other, different men arose over the centuries, speaking different tongues. Long afterward a researcher gathered what they had said. He found many names and many stories, and then he noticed that every notebook opened with the same sentence.

A question for you

If the message really were one, what would best show it to you?

If you sayThat the messengers agree at the core
ThenThat is the claim here, and it can be compared with what the prophets' own books contain.
If you sayThat it reached every nation
ThenThat is exactly what the next part takes up.
If you sayI do not expect any message at all
ThenAn honest position. Read what follows then as a claim to examine, not a creed to accept.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allāh and avoid ṭāghūt."[698] And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

Translator's notes

[698] False objects of worship.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:36

Translation

Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֶל־כָּל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם שָׁבִים֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה הָסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֧י הַנֵּכָ֛ר מִתּוֹכְכֶ֖ם וְהָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְהָכִ֨ינוּ לְבַבְכֶ֤ם אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וְעִבְדֻ֣הוּ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְיַצֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

1 Samuel · 7:3

World English Bible

Many of history's messengers have no story in the Book. Picture one, in a village time has forgotten, telling their people: serve none but God, then dying with no name written down. The text says this happened in every nation. Your own first ancestor may have walked close to that voice.

A question for you

What, if anything, do you obey more than it deserves?

Part 3 of 3

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13

﴿مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

Quran · Fussilat 41:43

The verse gives Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus one charge, together with the one it addresses. Picture neighbours passing a lamp along a long darkness, each saying the same two things to the next: keep it lit, and do not break it between you. That is the shape of what the verse says: hold to the religion, and do not split over it.

A question for you

If the order was one and all the messengers carried it, where would you look for the cause of division among their followers?

If you sayIn the followers themselves
ThenThat is what the very next verse, 42:14, says, and it is where the road goes.
If you sayIn differences between the messages
ThenA serious objection, and a question takes it up: if the laws differ, is it the same religion?
If you sayI doubt the messages were one
ThenThen look at the opening words of four messengers, side by side.

The same in the other books

Translation

Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”
